answer: Proof of Stake establishes Sybil resistance by tying identity to capital, forcing an attacker to acquire tokens to influence the network summit. This mechanism prevents malicious agents from flooding the system with fake personas, as the cost scales linearly with the stake required. By enforcing cryptographic signatures via a private cipher, the protocol treats individual nodes like solidified basalt, ensuring immutability against sybil-based voting manipulation without exhausting network resources.
